title: SessionIntentParams
description: Structured interactive intent from the pane controller. The helper runtime encodes it against modes the program set; this is never PTY bytes.

accessEpoch.description: The pane access epoch the controller last observed, or 0/absent when it has none yet (an open that could not read one). It is not defaulted to anything: any value that is not the epoch in force is refused access_revoked with zero bytes, and the result names the epoch in force — so a controller with none writes nothing and learns the one to present (nocx-zg3k3.3.1).

kind.description: Which kind of input the person produced. It is the whole of sessionruntime's intent vocabulary (internal/sessionruntime/contract.go's IntentKind) and not a printable subset: a click and a focus change are input too, and the pane's own renderer is the only source of them (nocx-zg3k3.3.1, design §6.1).

framing.description: How a paste is framed, for kind paste only (nocx-evj4b.1.2). Absent or auto means the runtime's own rule: bracketed only when the program enabled mode 2004. bare means never bracketed — a composer submit to a shell whose integration is live, where the editor is the protection and a mode belief over ssh cannot be trusted. The runtime still owns the encoding (byte stripping, newline to carriage return); the caller only says whether the program's mode may frame it.

payload.description: The intent's own argument, and its shape is the kind's: a key name with modifier prefixes ("Ctrl+Up"), committed UTF-8 text, a verbatim paste body, a mouse event as "<action> <button> <x> <y>" in cell coordinates ("press left 12 5"), or "in"/"out" for focus.
